unit.why: A short memorate: on Yom Kippur, during the recital of the Temple service, the Apter Rav exclaimed that he remembered serving as High Priest in the Temple.

stories.summary_en: The author heard in his youth that the Apter Rav (R. Abraham Joshua Heschel) used to say during the Yom Kippur Avodah, 'and thus I would say', because he still remembered serving as High Priest in the Temple.
